# Aminyx — Aminjon Azizov, full-stack developer & security engineer

> Personal portfolio site (every project is shown with an interactive 3D model of its core mechanic): end-to-end product development — backend (Go, Rust, Python), Android (Kotlin), web, Telegram bots, security and infrastructure, LLM integrations. Everything in production with real traffic and payments. Site languages: Russian (/), English (/en/), Tajik (/tg/). Primary contact: Telegram.

## Projects

- [SomonVPN](https://somonvpn.tech): commercial VPN resistant to DPI blocking; Kotlin Android client, Go backend, monorepo with dashboard, desktop and bots; 2.5 months from empty repository to monetization
- [Cybersec](https://aminyx.github.io/Cybersec/): free open-source cybersecurity course (GPL-3.0) in Russian and Tajik — 270 days from zero to Junior, 6 exams, 10 portfolio projects
- [Aminyx Link](https://aminyx.top/#p-link): Rust network platform — multipath, failover, post-quantum cryptography (X25519 + ML-KEM-768), 731 automated tests; private development
- [Somoni Tracker](https://github.com/aminyx/somoni-tracker): Telegram expense tracker (grammY bot + Next.js dashboard on one core, SQLite); 3rd place at CodeCup.tech; open source, 218 tests
- [maryam.best](https://maryam.best): client portfolio site in three languages, Next.js 16, 3D DNA scene
- [Open source written from scratch](https://aminyx.top/#oss): keelstore (LSM key-value store), keelsql (SQL engine), hnsw (vector index), sable (language compiling to WebAssembly), driftpad (hand-written CRDT), pulsewire (realtime WebSocket), keyforge (OpenID Connect), evalgate (prompt regression tests), actions-lock (GitHub Actions pinning)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aminyx): all repositories
